## Verdict

## Concerns
- The column-completeness conclusion is assumed through
  \[
  M_{d+k}=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i+1)^{j+1},\,|\mu|=d+k}\mathbb Zs_\mu,
  \]
  rather than derived from the stipulated box/Schur/Pieri presentation.
- Likewise, completeness of the \(h_1\)-rows is explicitly assumed. The subsequent path-incidence and unimodular-minor arguments are correct conditional consequences, but they do not prove these two requested completeness assertions.
- Thus the requested target is not established unconditionally; only the conditional combinatorial reduction is proved.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Derive, without assuming either requested completeness statement, that the relevant degree-\(d+k\) module has exactly the Schur basis \(P_{x,k-x}\) and that its full \(h_1\)-row lattice consists exactly of the products \(P_{x+1,y}+P_{x,y+1}\); then append the already supplied endpoint unimodular-minor argument.
